gloss: guest of honor; VIP guest; invited guest

definitions.gloss: guest of honor; VIP guest; invited guest
definitions.explanation: A formally invited guest at a ceremony, reception, or official event — especially one whose status warrants special acknowledgment. Used in announcements, programs, and seating arrangements at weddings, graduations, and official functions.

examples.japanese: {来賓|らいひん}{席|せき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{案内|あんない}します→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll show you to the VIP seats.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{来賓|らいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Many honored guests attended the ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{来賓|らいひん}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The mayor gave the congratulatory address as a representative of the honored guests.

notes:
Compound of {来|らい} (come) + {賓|ひん} (guest). Refers specifically to formally invited guests at ceremonies and official events; not used for ordinary visitors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来賓|らいひん}{席|せき}: seats for honored guests
- {来賓|らいひん}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: representative of the honored guests
- {来賓|らいひん}⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: address by an honored guest
- ご{来賓|らいひん}: honored guests (with the polite prefix; standard in announcements)

USAGE:
The polite form ご{来賓|らいひん} is used when addressing or referring to guests in formal speech (e.g., school graduations, weddings, conferences).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貴賓|きひん}: distinguished guest — even higher status, often royalty or heads of state
- ⟦{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}→招待客：28262_shoutaikyaku⟧: invited guest — broader, includes ordinary invitees
- ⟦ゲスト→ゲスト：10849_gesuto⟧: guest — generic English loanword, more casual
